title.value: Statistical Detection of Adversarial examples in Blockchain-based Federated Forest In-vehicle Network Intrusion Detection Systems
title.justification: The title clearly describes the focus of the paper, which is the detection of adversarial examples in a specific type of network intrusion detection system.
title.quote: Statistical Detection of Adversarial examples in Blockchain-based Federated Forest In-vehicle Network Intrusion Detection Systems

extractions.description: This paper investigates the impact of adversarial examples on Blockchain-based Federated Forest In-vehicle Network Intrusion Detection Systems (BFF-IDS) and proposes the integration of a statistical detector to detect and manage these adversarial examples. By doing so, it aims to enhance the security framework to guard against adversarial attacks on such systems.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on cybersecurity within in-vehicle networks using adversarial machine learning and blockchain technologies. While this contributes to technological advancement in smart cities, the paper does not directly address climate or ecologically-related sustainable development themes.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: This paper investigates the impact of various possible adversarial examples on the BFF-IDS.

primary_category.justification: While the paper discusses technologies like blockchain and machine learning within the context of vehicle networks, it is primarily focused on security and does not have a central theme related to climate or ecology.
primary_category.quote: The proposed integration of the statistical adversarial detector and the subsequent augmentation of the BFF-IDS with detected adversarial samples provides a sustainable security framework against adversarial examples and other unknown attacks.
